Guide\n\nA small, deterministic Sinatra API for D&D 5e DM helpers: dice, character math,\ncombat state, compendium, campaign management, play-by-post campaigns, and\nencounter mechanics. There are no background jobs, no external services, and a\nsingle SQLite database file.\n\n## Runtime versions\n\nThe Gemfile pins the runtime/framework versions used by this workspace:\n\n- Ruby 4.0.5\n- Sinatra 4.2.1\n- Rack 3.2.6\n- Rackup 2.3.1\n- Puma 8.0.2\n- sqlite3 2.9.5\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nbundle install\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` starts the server in the foreground on `127.0.0.1`, using the `PORT`\nenvironment variable. It also removes and recreates `game.db` on every launch so\neach run begins with a fresh schema.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n```\napp.rb                    # Sinatra setup, shared helpers, route requires\nlib/\n  auth.rb                 # Bearer-token authentication and password hashing\n  game_logic.rb           # Pure D&D 5e calculations and encounter constants\n  storage.rb              # SQLite persistence layer\n  validation.rb           # Input validation helpers\n  routes/                 # Domain route files (loaded in precedence order)\n    core.rb               # Health, dice, checks, initiative, encounter XP\n    characters.rb         # Ability modifier, proficiency, derived stats\n    combat_sessions.rb    # Combat session state and conditions\n    auth.rb               # User registration and login\n    storage.rb            # Storage status and reset\n    compendium.rb         # Monster and item compendium\n    campaigns.rb          # Campaigns, quests, factions/NPCs, inventory\n    phb.rb                # PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests, load)\n    dm_tools.rb           # DM encounter builder, loot, session recap\n    downtime.rb           # Crafting projects\n    sessions.rb           # Session scheduling, attendance, audit, analytics\n    play_lobby.rb         # Play campaign creation, membership, start\n    play_turns.rb         # Narrations, actions, resolutions, turn views\n    play_document.rb      # Campaign story / dm_notes document\n    play_scenes.rb        # Scene state\n    play_locations.rb     # Location graph\n    play_travel_rest.rb   # Travel and rest turns\n    play_encounters.rb    # Encounters, roster, combat turns, actions, rewards\n    play_characters.rb    # Character damage, death saves, build, level-up\nrun.sh                    # Foreground server launcher\nGemfile                   # Version pins\n```\n\n`app.rb` requires the four helper modules, configures the server bind address\nand port, initializes the SQLite schema, registers the helper modules, defines\nshared request helpers, and then loads the route files.\n\nThe app uses **classic Sinatra** style (`require 'sinatra'` and routes defined at\nthe top level), so `bundle exec ruby app.rb` works directly.\n\n## State, persistence, and request-routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db` (SQLite). The `Storage` module owns every\nSQL statement and the single shared database connection.\n\n- `Storage::DB_PATH` resolves to the project-root `game.db`.\n- `Storage::DB_MUTEX` serializes all database access because Puma may serve\n  requests concurrently and the Ruby `sqlite3` connection object is not\n  thread-safe for unsynchronized use.\n- `Storage::SCHEMA_VERSION` is `1`. It is recorded in the `schema_info` table on\n  first boot.\n- JSON is stored as text columns (`*_json`) and parsed/serialized by the\n  storage layer. `Storage.json_column(row, column, default)` centralizes the\n  parse step; `Storage.ensure_column!(db, table, column, definition)` runs the\n  incremental schema migrations so older databases can be reopened safely.\n\nSchema is created on boot by `Storage.init_schema!`. Tables are created with\n`IF NOT EXISTS`, so restarts are safe. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint\n(and `Storage.reset!`) drops and recreates all tables for tests.\n\nKey tables:\n\n- `combat_sessions` — turn order, active round/turn, and per-target conditions.\n- `users` — username, password hash, role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `compendium_monsters` / `compendium_items` — stat blocks and magic items.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — base campaigns.\n- `campaign_quests` — quest headers, milestones, completed milestones.\n- `campaign_factions` / `campaign_npcs` — factions and their NPCs.\n- `campaign_inventory` — party and per-character item quantities.\n- `campaign_crafting_projects` — downtime crafting state.\n- `campaign_sessions` / `campaign_session_attendance` — scheduled sessions and\n  attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_narrations` —\n  owned live-play campaigns, party membership, and ordered narration/action/\n  resolution events. `play_campaigns` stores the durable campaign document\n  (`story`, `dm_notes`), turn queue, turn number, scene/location state, and\n  pre-combat exploration state.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` / `play_campaign_locations` /\n  `play_campaign_location_connections` — scene and location graph.\n- `play_campaign_encounters` / `play_campaign_encounter_monsters` — active\n  encounters, monster roster, bound party combatants, conditions, readies,\n  rewards, and cached initiative order.\n\n### Routing\n\nRoutes are grouped by domain in `lib/routes/`. Each file contains only Sinatra\nroute definitions and delegates persistence and math to `Storage` and\n`GameLogic`. Files are loaded from `app.rb` in precedence order, so route\nmatching order matches the original monolithic layout.\n\nEvery successful JSON route calls `content_type :json` before producing the\nbody. Error halts use `json_error(status, message)`, which sets the\n`application/json` content type and a JSON body `{\"error\":\"...\"}`. The\n`POST /v1/dice/stats` route intentionally omits the explicit content type on\nits validation halt, preserving original behavior.\n\n### Helper modules\n\n- `GameLogic` — pure functions (ability modifier, proficiency, initiative order,\n  encounter XP/difficulty). No side effects; easy to test in isolation.\n- `Validation` — input guards that may `halt` with a 400 response. They depend on\n  the request context through the `json_error` helper.\n- `Auth` — bearer-token extraction, password hashing, and role enforcement.\n  Uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with a username-derived salt.\n\nShared application helpers live in the anonymous `helpers` block in `app.rb`:\n\n- `parse_json_body` — read and parse JSON; halt 400 on parse errors.\n- `find_combat_session!` — load a combat session or halt 404.\n- `combat_session_response(session, extra = {})` — format a session for the\n  public API.\n- `json_error(status, message)` — uniform JSON halt helper.\n- `require_campaign_exists!(campaign_id)` — validate id and halt 404.\n- `load_play_campaign!(campaign_id)` — load a play campaign or halt 404.\n- `require_play_campaign_access!` / `require_play_campaign_owner!` —\n  membership/ownership guards.\n- `load_play_encounter!(campaign_id, enc_id, username, require_owner: false)` —\n  shared campaign/encounter loading and access/ownership enforcement used by the\n  encounter route group.\n- `current_actor_for(campaign, turn_number = nil)` — deterministic actor whose\n  turn it is from the turn queue.\n- `phase_for(actor)` — map actor name to `dm` or `player`.\n- `advance_play_campaign_turn!` / `advance_to_dm_phase_and_turn!` /\n  `advance_to_dm_phase!` — turn-queue advancement helpers.\n- `encounter_order` / `encounter_order_for` / `refresh_encounter_order!` / `recompute_encounter_order!` —\n  deterministic initiative order for campaign encounters; `recompute_encounter_order!`\n  reloads the roster before refreshing so route files do not duplicate that logic.\n- `encounter_active(combatant)` — public shape for an active combatant.\n- `condition_key_for(combatant)` — condition-storage key for a combatant.\n- `valid_encounter_target?` — roster membership check for condition targets.\n- `apply_condition_decay_for_active!` — decrement and purge expired conditions\n  at the start of a turn.\n- `campaign_readiness_signals` — compute readiness flags and active quest count.\n- `play_turn_deadline` / `play_logical_deadline` — deterministic deadlines from\n  turn number.\n- `encounter_calculation(party, monster_slugs)` — campaign-aware encounter\n  builder that loads compendium monsters and halts 404 if any slug is missing.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Notes |\n|-------|-----------|-------|\n| Core | `GET /health`, `POST /v1/dice/stats`, `POST /v1/checks/ability`, `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `POST /v1/initiative/order` | Deterministic math; AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      assigned_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'healing-potion', 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions_available = healing_potions ? healing_potions['quantity'] : 0\n\n      {\n        party_items: party_items,\n        assigned_items: assigned_items,\n        healing_potions_available: healing_potions_available\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign sessions ---\n\n  def self.campaign_session_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_campaign_session(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_project(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      id: row['id'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      item_slug: row['item_slug'],\n      days_required: row['days_required'],\n      days_completed: row['days_completed'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      cost_gp: row['cost_gp']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, cost_gp)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_crafting_projects (campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, status, cost_gp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, 0, 'active', cost_gp]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.advance_project(campaign_id, id, days)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        row = db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id])\n        return nil unless row\n\n        new_completed = [row['days_completed'] + days, row['days_required']].min\n        status = new_completed >= row['days_required'] ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n        db.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          [new_completed, status, campaign_id, id]\n        )\n\n        if status == 'complete'\n          existing = db.get_first_row(\n            'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n          )\n          if existing\n            db.execute(\n              'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n              [existing['quantity'] + 1, campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n            )\n          else\n            db.execute(\n              'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n              [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party', 1]\n            )\n          end\n        end\n\n        { id: row['id'], days_completed: new_completed, status: status }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaigns ---\n\n  def self.play_campaign_exists?(id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_play_campaign(id, name, owner, max_players)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaigns (id, name, owner, status, phase, max_players, current_actor, turn_number, queue_json, nudge_count, story, dm_notes, current_scene_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [id, name, owner, 'lobby', nil, max_players, nil, nil, JSON.dump(nil), 0, '', '', nil]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign(id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      id: row['id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      owner: row['owner'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      phase: row['phase'],\n      max_players: row['max_players'],\n      current_actor: row['current_actor'],\n      turn_number: row['turn_number'],\n      queue: json_column(row, 'queue_json'),\n      nudge_count: row['nudge_count'],\n      current_scene_id: row['current_scene_id'],\n      current_location_id: row['current_location_id'],\n      pre_combat_state: json_column(row, 'pre_combat_state_json')\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_current_location(id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT current_location_id FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.set_current_location(id, location_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_location_id = ? 'dm' : 'player'\n\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET status = ?, phase = ?, current_actor = ?, turn_number = ?, queue_json = ?, pre_combat_state_json = NULL WHERE id = ?',\n        ['active', phase, current_actor, turn_number, JSON.dump(queue), id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_member(campaign_id, username)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?', [campaign_id, username]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      username: row['username'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      class: row['class'],\n      race: row['race'],\n      background: row['background'],\n      level: row['level'] || 1,\n      abilities: Storage.json_column(row, 'abilities_json', {}),\n      hp_current: row['hp_current'] || 20,\n      hp_max: row['hp_max'] || 20,\n      status: row['status'] || 'conscious',\n      successes: row['death_save_successes'] || 0,\n      failures: row['death_save_failures'] || 0,\n      owner: row['owner']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_member_by_character_id(campaign_id, character_id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      username: row['username'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      class: row['class'],\n      race: row['race'],\n      background: row['background'],\n      level: row['level'] || 1,\n      abilities: Storage.json_column(row, 'abilities_json', {}),\n      hp_current: row['hp_current'] || 20,\n      hp_max: row['hp_max'] || 20,\n      status: row['status'] || 'conscious',\n      successes: row['death_save_successes'] || 0,\n      failures: row['death_save_failures'] || 0,\n      owner: row['owner']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.set_character_owner(campaign_id, character_id, owner)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET owner = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [new_level, new_hp_max, new_hp_current, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n    end\n    load_play_campaign_member_by_character_id(campaign_id, character_id)\n  end\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_member_hp(campaign_id, username, hp_current)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?', [campaign_id, username])\n      current_status = row ? row['status'] : 'conscious'\n\n      new_status = if hp_current > 0\n                     'conscious'\n                   elsif %w[stable dead].include?(current_status)\n                     current_status\n                   else\n                     'unconscious'\n                   end\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [hp_current, new_status, campaign_id, username]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.apply_damage_to_character(campaign_id, character_id, amount)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT hp_current, hp_max, status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id])\n      return nil unless row\n\n      hp_before = row['hp_current'].to_i\n      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n\n      new_status = if hp_after > 0\n                     'conscious'\n                   elsif %w[stable dead].include?(row['status'])\n                     row['status']\n                   else\n                     'unconscious'\n                   end\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [hp_after, new_status, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n\n      {\n        character_id: character_id,\n        hp_before: hp_before,\n        hp_after: hp_after,\n        damage: hp_before - hp_after,\n        hp_max: row['hp_max'].to_i,\n        status: new_status\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.record_death_save(campaign_id, character_id, outcome)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id])\n      return nil unless row\n\n      successes = row['death_save_successes'].to_i\n      failures = row['death_save_failures'].to_i\n      status = row['status']\n\n      if outcome == 'success'\n        successes += 1\n        status = 'stable' if successes >= 3\n      else\n        failures += 1\n        status = 'dead' if failures >= 3\n      end\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [successes, failures, status, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n\n      {\n        character_id: character_id,\n        successes: successes,\n        failures: failures,\n        status: status\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Character spells ---\n\n  def self.load_character_spells(campaign_id, character_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT spell_id, name, level FROM play_campaign_character_spells WHERE campaign_id = ? Sequence numbers are per-campaign and monotonically\n  # increasing so the log order matches insertion order.\n  def self.insert_narration(campaign_id, kind, actor, type, text, target = nil)\n    with_db do |db|\n      sequence = (db.get_first_value('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) || 0).to_i + 1\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text]\n      )\n      sequence\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_narration(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'narration', actor, nil, text, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_action(campaign_id, actor, type, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'action', actor, type, text, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_resolution(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'resolution', actor, nil, text, nil)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_combat_action(campaign_id, actor, type, target, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'combat_action', actor, type, text, target)\n  end\n\n  def self.play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        result = { sequence: row['sequence'], kind: row['kind'], actor: row['actor'] }\n        result[:type] = row['type'] if row['type']\n        result[:target] = row['target'] if row['target']\n        result[:text] = row['text']\n        result\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign turn advancement ---\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_turn(campaign_id, current_actor, phase, turn_number)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, phase = ?, turn_number = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      assigned_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'healing-potion', 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions_available = healing_potions ? healing_potions['quantity'] : 0\n\n      {\n        party_items: party_items,\n        assigned_items: assigned_items,\n        healing_potions_available: healing_potions_available\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign sessions ---\n\n  def self.campaign_session_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      id: row['id'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      item_slug: row['item_slug'],\n      days_required: row['days_required'],\n      days_completed: row['days_completed'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      cost_gp: row['cost_gp']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, cost_gp)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_crafting_projects (campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, status, cost_gp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, 0, 'active', cost_gp]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.advance_project(campaign_id, id, days)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        row = db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id])\n        return nil unless row\n\n        new_completed = [row['days_completed'] + days, row['days_required']].min\n        status = new_completed >= row['days_required'] ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n        db.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          [new_completed, status, campaign_id, id]\n        )\n\n        if status == 'complete'\n          existing = db.get_first_row(\n            'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n          )\n          if existing\n            db.execute(\n              'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n              [existing['quantity'] + 1, campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n            )\n          else\n            db.execute(\n              'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n              [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party', 1]\n            )\n          end\n        end\n\n        { id: row['id'], days_completed: new_completed, status: status }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaigns ---\n\n  def self.play_campaign_exists?(id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_play_campaign(id, name, owner, max_players)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaigns (id, name, owner, status, phase, max_players, current_actor, turn_number, queue_json, nudge_count, story, dm_notes, current_scene_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [id, name, owner, 'lobby', nil, max_players, nil, nil, JSON.dump(nil), 0, '', '', nil]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign(id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      id: row['id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      owner: row['owner'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      phase: row['phase'],\n      max_players: row['max_players'],\n      current_actor: row['current_actor'],\n      turn_number: row['turn_number'],\n      queue: json_column(row, 'queue_json'),\n      nudge_count: row['nudge_count'],\n      current_scene_id: row['current_scene_id'],\n      current_location_id: row['current_location_id'],\n      pre_combat_state: json_column(row, 'pre_combat_state_json')\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_current_location(id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT current_location_id FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.set_current_location(id, location_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_location_id = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [location_id, id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_document(id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT story, dm_notes FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [id]) }\n    return { story: '', dm_notes: '' } unless row\n\n    {\n      story: row['story'] || '',\n      dm_notes: row['dm_notes'] || ''\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_document(id, story, dm_notes)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET story = ?, dm_notes = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [story, dm_notes, id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign members ---\n\n  def self.play_campaign_member_exists?(campaign_id, username)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.play_campaign_member_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_play_campaign_member(campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class_name)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_members (campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class, level, hp_current, hp_max, owner) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, username, character_id, name, class_name, 1, 20, 20, username]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.play_campaign_members(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT username, character_id, name, class, owner FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        { username: row['username'], character_id: row['character_id'], name: row['name'], class: row['class'], owner: row['owner'] }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.start_play_campaign(id, queue, turn_number)\n    current_actor = queue.first\n    phase = current_actor == 'dm' ? 'dm' : 'player'\n\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaigns SET status = ?, phase = ?, current_actor = ?, turn_number = ?, queue_json = ?, pre_combat_state_json = NULL WHERE id = ?',\n        ['active', phase, current_actor, turn_number, JSON.dump(queue), id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_member(campaign_id, username)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?', [campaign_id, username]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      username: row['username'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      class: row['class'],\n      race: row['race'],\n      background: row['background'],\n      level: row['level'] || 1,\n      abilities: Storage.json_column(row, 'abilities_json', {}),\n      hp_current: row['hp_current'] || 20,\n      hp_max: row['hp_max'] || 20,\n      status: row['status'] || 'conscious',\n      successes: row['death_save_successes'] || 0,\n      failures: row['death_save_failures'] || 0,\n      owner: row['owner']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_play_campaign_member_by_character_id(campaign_id, character_id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      username: row['username'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      name: row['name'],\n      class: row['class'],\n      race: row['race'],\n      background: row['background'],\n      level: row['level'] || 1,\n      abilities: Storage.json_column(row, 'abilities_json', {}),\n      hp_current: row['hp_current'] || 20,\n      hp_max: row['hp_max'] || 20,\n      status: row['status'] || 'conscious',\n      successes: row['death_save_successes'] || 0,\n      failures: row['death_save_failures'] || 0,\n      owner: row['owner']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.set_character_owner(campaign_id, character_id, owner)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET owner = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [owner, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.set_character_build(campaign_id, character_id, race, class_name, background, level, abilities, hp_max)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET race = ?, class = ?, background = ?, level = ?, abilities_json = ?, hp_max = ?, hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [race, class_name, background, level, JSON.dump(abilities), hp_max, hp_max, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.level_up_character(campaign_id, character_id, new_level, new_hp_max, new_hp_current)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET level = ?, hp_max = ?, hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [new_level, new_hp_max, new_hp_current, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n    end\n    load_play_campaign_member_by_character_id(campaign_id, character_id)\n  end\n\n  def self.update_play_campaign_member_hp(campaign_id, username, hp_current)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?', [campaign_id, username])\n      current_status = row ? row['status'] : 'conscious'\n\n      new_status = if hp_current > 0\n                     'conscious'\n                   elsif %w[stable dead].include?(current_status)\n                     current_status\n                   else\n                     'unconscious'\n                   end\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [hp_current, new_status, campaign_id, username]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.apply_damage_to_character(campaign_id, character_id, amount)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT hp_current, hp_max, status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id])\n      return nil unless row\n\n      hp_before = row['hp_current'].to_i\n      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n\n      new_status = if hp_after > 0\n                     'conscious'\n                   elsif %w[stable dead].include?(row['status'])\n                     row['status']\n                   else\n                     'unconscious'\n                   end\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [hp_after, new_status, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n\n      {\n        character_id: character_id,\n        hp_before: hp_before,\n        hp_after: hp_after,\n        damage: hp_before - hp_after,\n        hp_max: row['hp_max'].to_i,\n        status: new_status\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.record_death_save(campaign_id, character_id, outcome)\n    with_db do |db|\n      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id])\n      return nil unless row\n\n      successes = row['death_save_successes'].to_i\n      failures = row['death_save_failures'].to_i\n      status = row['status']\n\n      if outcome == 'success'\n        successes += 1\n        status = 'stable' if successes >= 3\n      else\n        failures += 1\n        status = 'dead' if failures >= 3\n      end\n\n      db.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [successes, failures, status, campaign_id, character_id]\n      )\n\n      {\n        character_id: character_id,\n        successes: successes,\n        failures: failures,\n        status: status\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Character spells ---\n\n  def self.load_character_spells(campaign_id, character_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT spell_id, name, level FROM play_campaign_character_spells WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? ORDER BY rowid',\n        [campaign_id, character_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        { spell_id: row['spell_id'], name: row['name'], level: row['level'] }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.add_character_spell(campaign_id, character_id, spell_id, name, level)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO play_campaign_character_spells (campaign_id, character_id, spell_id, name, level) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, character_id, spell_id, name, level]\n      )\n      db.changes > 0\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.increment_nudge_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute('UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = nudge_count + 1 WHERE id = ?', [campaign_id])\n      db.get_first_value('SELECT nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', [campaign_id])\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Play campaign narrations ---\n\n  # Inserts a single narration/action/resolution event and returns its\n  # sequence number. AND username = ?',\n+        [hp_current, new_status, campaign_id, username]\n+      )\n+    end\n+  end\n+\n+  def self.apply_damage_to_character(campaign_id, character_id, amount)\n+    with_db do |db|\n+      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT hp_current, hp_max, status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id])\n+      return nil unless row\n+\n+      hp_before = row['hp_current'].to_i\n+      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n+\n+      new_status = if hp_after > 0\n+                     'conscious'\n+                   elsif %w[stable dead].include?(row['status'])\n+                     row['status']\n+                   else\n+                     'unconscious'\n+                   end\n+\n+      db.execute(\n+        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n+        [hp_after, new_status, campaign_id, character_id]\n+      )\n+\n+      {\n+        character_id: character_id,\n+        hp_before: hp_before,\n+        hp_after: hp_after,\n+        damage: hp_before - hp_after,\n+        hp_max: row['hp_max'].to_i,\n+        status: new_status\n+      }\n+    end\n+  end\n+\n+  def self.record_death_save(campaign_id, character_id, outcome)\n+    with_db do |db|\n+      row = db.get_first_row('SELECT status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?', [campaign_id, character_id])\n+      return nil unless row\n+\n+      successes = row['death_save_successes'].to_i\n+      failures = row['death_save_failures'].to_i\n+      status = row['status']\n+\n+      if outcome == 'success'\n+        successes += 1\n+        status = 'stable' if successes >= 3\n+      else\n+        failures += 1\n+        status = 'dead' if failures >= 3\n+      end\n+\n+      db.execute(\n+        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n+        [successes, failures, status, campaign_id, character_id]\n+      )\n+\n+      {\n+        character_id: character_id,\n+        successes: successes,\n+        failures: failures,\n+        status: status\n+      }\n+    end\n+  end\n+\n+  # --- Character spells ---\n+\n+  def self.load_character_spells(campaign_id, character_id)\n+    with_db do |db|\n+      db.execute(\n+        'SELECT spell_id, name, level FROM play_campaign_character_spells WHERE campaign_id = ? Returns a result hash or nil if the target is\n+  # not found or not a bound combatant.\n+  def self.apply_damage_to_encounter_target(campaign_id, encounter_id, target, amount)\n+    with_db do |db|\n+      monster_row = db.get_first_row(\n+        'SELECT hp_max, hp_current FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ?
